name: sphica
description: The memory of past implementation and decisions for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: sphica
plugins.description: Records Claude Code and Codex sessions on your machine and keeps past implementation and decisions, with their sources, for your agent to find.

plugins.name: sphica-pane
plugins.description: Optional, Claude Code only: a pane that lists what Sphica's hooks handed the agent in this session. Install sphica first.
